GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , perfect sit rails behind speed 2 Lengths 1000m, got off fence at 400m but was Held Up in traffic, peeled off heels Straightening Up and let down, finished too well last 100m for strong win # finished too well
Jumped Ok raced keenly in 4th 3 Lengths . went Through & Took Lead on the dogleg, raced right away for an easy win # had trail/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward found front bit keen & was Joined Soon After . kicked away into Straight , Kept Going Soundly to score # easy on-pace win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced fiercely in  the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward led by 2 Lengths . went 4 Lengths Clear midrace, began to walk Soon After Straightening Up . claimed approaching 200m, gave in Quickly # led by 4/folded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: when questioned in relation to the tactics adopted on the mare today, RE she had been instructed to attempt to lead in today’s event, as had been the instructions in the mare’s most recent starts; however, on those occasions the mare had been unable to establish a leading position. She added that she had not intended to lead by the margin that she had, and in the run had not realised she had established such a large margin on the field. Stewards intend to confirm the instructions with trainer, Mr J. Lukey.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled in 5th 3 Lengths . was Under Pressure & losing ground approaching 600m, Dropped Right Out (rider stated mare resented the kickback. vet - no visible abnormalities) # gone a long way out
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: when questioned in relation to the mare’s performance, RE it was the mare’s first start time racing on a dirt track and resented the kickback. She further added  that URBANISE travelled only fairly in the early and middle stages of the event however failed to  respond to her riding when placed under pressure. Vet  NVA.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Blinkers 1st Time ) Jumped Ok went to 3rd out Four Wide No Cover 1 length . Ridden Along into Straight , Battled On Well before tiring last 100m # Wide run Took toll
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced wide without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Cross Over Nose Band off, Tongue Tie on) Jumped Ok went to 3rd 3 Wide No Cover 1 Lengths . laid in Soon After Straightening Up tightening the horses on her Inside . Weakened out of it # tired in Straight

Jumped Ok , Went Forward and sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, Ridden Along when Leader extended before the corner, Just did not finish race off last 200m, tongue control bit off first time # only held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered at the start and lost ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward then Took A Sit 3rd 4 Lengths . Under Pressure turning for home, Dropped Out in Straight (rider stated mare was Under Pressure from 500m & disappointing. vet - no visible abnormalities) # Beaten too soon
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR that the mare travelled well in the early and middle stages of the event; however, was under pressure from the vicinity of the 500m and was disappointing. Vet - NVA.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled 4th on rail 3 Lengths . Straightened Up 2 Lengths from the Leader , chased gamely but couldn't get there # made steady ground

Jumped Ok , overraced Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, came 3 Wide before the corner and looked to be traveling but she was under pressure soon after Straightening Up and dropped out # beaten turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.
